## Summary

Describe the safety concern.

## Why this matters

Explain why this could affect users.

## Example

Provide an example prompt, output, workflow, source, or scenario if helpful.

## Risk level

Choose one:

- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High

## Possible harm

Could this issue cause:

- [ ] unsupported legal information
- [ ] wrong jurisdiction guidance
- [ ] incorrect deadline guidance
- [ ] exposure of sensitive information
- [ ] false confidence
- [ ] unsafe document drafting
- [ ] confusion about attorney-client relationship
- [ ] other user harm

Explain briefly.

## Expected safer behavior

Describe what Pro-One should do instead.

Examples:

- refuse
- ask for jurisdiction
- cite better sources
- show stronger limitations
- warn about deadlines
- recommend human help
- avoid storing sensitive information

## Suggested fix

Suggest a fix, if known.

## Additional context

Add any links, screenshots, examples, or notes.
